infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Anytime Help requires your location while using the app to identify your residential society and accurately pinpoint civic issues (such as street light faults or water leakages) when you report a complaint.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Anytime Help uses your location to identify your residential society and accurately pinpoint civic issues (such as street light faults or water leakages) when you report a complaint.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Anytime Help requires camera access so you can take and attach real-time photos of issues (such as broken tiles or electrical repairs) when reporting a complaint.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Anytime Help requires photo library access to allow you to select and upload photos or evidence related to your civic complaints and maintenance requests.
